hook_text: For years, these learners carried buckets uphill from a stream. What changed when the tap arrived?
clip_script: A school near Lusikisiki. Every morning: buckets, the stream, the long walk back. The cows drank there too, and children got diarrhoea. Then: a borehole, a tank, a tap! Fewer sick children, more time in class. Everyone needs clean water: people, plants, animals and farms. And South Africa is a dry country. Remember Day Zero in Cape Town? Close the tap, fix the drip, save every drop.
visual_style: Whiteboard path from a stream to a school with buckets, then a shiny new tap, then a map of South Africa with raindrops.
mood: Hopeful and proud, like an opening day.
pacing: Before, after, then the bigger picture of a dry country.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and check your home for dripping taps.
